t: You are at the Iraq and Afghanistan Memorial in Victoria Embankment Gardens, between the River Thames and the Ministry of Defence headquarters. It commemorates British military personnel and civilians who took part in the Gulf War, the Afghanistan War and the Iraq War. Across those conflicts, between 1990 and 2015, 682 British service personnel died. The memorial is the work of the sculptor Paul Day, and it stands close to monuments for the Second World War and the Korean War.
